title: The New Testament of Jesus Christ; and The Holie Bible Faithfully Translated into English out of the Authentical Latin
source_format: JSON source tree in a GitHub tag archive
source_edition: Rheims New Testament (1582) and Douai Old Testament (1609-1610), original unrevised translation and apparatus, structured release v1.0
contributors: The English College at Rheims and Douai
notes: Provisional net-new candidate. It is not the Challoner revision identified by current WorkCatalog resource drc. The v1.0 source claims 73 books but contains 77 tagged members: 73 canonical books, 3 Esdras, 4 Esdras, Prayer of Manasses, and an exact duplicate Prayer-of-Manasses filename. The converter retains and accounts for that discrepancy explicitly.
